1.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_MINSTREL_GREETING_000
1.description: As a sinner of the world, you must surely have all manner of exciting experiences to share. I pray you regale me with your finest, that it may inspire me to write a song that shall echo in eternity.

4.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_MINSTREL_NOSELECT_000
4.description: You've neither the time nor the inclination? A pity, but as you like. I will be here, eager and waiting should you be willing and able to indulge me anon.

5.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_MINSTREL_NOCONTENT_000
5.description: ...Or rather I would, though I doubt any of your latest exploits will suffice. Not to belittle them, but what I seek are stories of only the greatest and grandest battles. Even the most skilled minstrel will struggle to entertain an audience with tales of everyday do-goodery.

7.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_002
7.description: The most esteemed of all fae folk, the venerated ruler of the pixies and the Kingdom of Rainbows. What tragedy for Titania to go forth in defense of their subjects, only to be corrupted and transformed into that which they fought to defeat...

8.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_003
8.description: A mad monarch, once beloved, then feared, and finally set free...

9.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_004
9.description: There, 'tis done. And you shall be the first to hear it performed.

10.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_005
10.description: For love of the fae folk the King fought Light and fell,♪<hex:02100103>Pure spirit, corrupted, in thrall to Light's spell,♪

11.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_006
11.description: Four treasures did lead <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> unto the castle door,♪<hex:02100103>Four treasures did free the king from torment evermore...♪

12.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_007
12.description: I can only imagine the horror that must have gripped Titania in the moments before the transformation was complete. Knowing that the very people you had sworn to protect would soon suffer and die by your hand...

13.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_008
13.description: It is an all-too-familiar tale to those of us who have struggled to survive in the wake of the Flood. We can but hope that the night's return is of comfort to their soul, should some aspect of it endure.

14.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_009
14.description: With the passing of the Light, the fae now dance beneath starlit skies. Where before they mourned, they now rejoice. You made this possible, my friend.

15.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_010
15.description: I look forward to hearing more of your adventures.

16.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_050
16.description: You have a tale for me, my friend?

17.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_051
17.description: The benevolent savior who would lord over paradise itself. The only ruler fit for a stagnant monument to hedonistic excess─Lord Vauthry. But of course he would claim the title of Innocence for himself in the end.

18.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_052
18.description: I cannot speak to whether or not he was a monster as a child, but I can sing of his monstrous deeds and what became of him as a man.

19.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_053
19.description: Beneath blinding skies the lord of Light reigns supreme,♪<hex:02100103>From his lofty perch to floating fortress he retreats to plot and scheme,♪

20.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_054
20.description: Heavenly exile, born of man and sin, embrace your ascension,♪<hex:02100103>And fall, Warden resplendent, in vain pursuit of perfection...♪<hex:02100103>

21.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_055
21.description: Though he summoned every onze of his strength as a champion of Light, in the end Vauthry was no match for the Warriors of Darkness.

22.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_056
22.description: He wouldn't be the first to cloak himself in the trappings of righteousness. They are too common by half, some might even say. Nevertheless, I hope his example serves as a reminder of what evil men may do in the name of so-called good.

23.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_057
23.description: You and yours did well to lay him low. No doubt you will confront other villains in the days ahead─and I should be most eager to hear your full account after.

24.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_060
24.description: “Hades”...? I have traversed countless lands and heard innumerable tales, and yet that name is unfamiliar to me. Pray tell me more.

25.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_061
25.description: The very man who flooded this world in Light, that its extinction might bring about the Rejoining he sought... An Ascian who lived a thousand thousand lives in pursuit of this single-minded goal until he fell...at your hand.

26.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_062
26.description: There is a part of me that cannot help but feel that it is not my place to tell this man's story. To sing of the ambitions that spurred him to wreak such wanton destruction, and those that compelled you to see that his dream would die in vain.

27.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_063
27.description: And yet, if you will permit me a moment's indulgence and a measure of poetic license, I would grace your ears with a tune. I call it, “Requiem for a Hero.”

28.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_064
28.description: His homeland lost to memory,<hex:02100103>through eons did he strive.♪<hex:02100103>Dark masks he wore, fell plots he hatched,<hex:02100103>to keep vain hope alive.♪

29.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_065
29.description: Until the end, that fateful day,<hex:02100103>when shadow clashed with light.♪<hex:02100103>True name revealed, his dying wish:<hex:02100103>remember us as we fade into night.♪

30.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_066
30.description: ...A most challenging subject to put into words, indeed. And yet, I can take some small solace in knowing that the entirety of the tale, in all its tragic and terrible glory, will live on within you.

31.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_067
31.description: I must say, I find it quite fascinating how this Emet-Selch chose to reveal his true name on the verge of the battle that would prove to be his downfall. I am reminded that the Night's Blessed have a similar tradition, in which they conceal their true names outside of rare occasions, such as funerals...

32.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_068
32.description: What significance might the act of announcing his true name have carried for him? A matter to ponder, perhaps, should you wish to fully grasp the nature of your foe─of the shadow to your light...

33.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_070
33.description: The Warrior of Light <hex:021A020203>incarnate<hex:021A020103>, you say? Consider me intrigued. Pray tell me this tale.

34.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_071
34.description: That such a fierce battle unfolded atop the tower, the culmination of a conflict spanning eons...

35.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_072
35.description: And by your hand did you strike down this Elidibus, thereby putting an end to the Ascian menace.

36.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_073
36.description: Had you not prevailed, we would not be enjoying the peace which we now have. We all owe you a tremendous debt.

37.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_074
37.description: And yet...I cannot help but spare a thought for the defeated. Though history will paint them as villains, the Ascians were driven by a deep and abiding desire to which all men may relate.

38.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_075
38.description: When one imagines the anguish and sorrow they must have felt, victory seems to lose its savor...

39.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_076
39.description: So such thoughts trouble even <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> who dealt the felling blow.

40.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_077
40.description: I am neither a philosopher nor a leader─just another minstrel. So pray allow me to speak of it in a language that is near and dear to a minstrel's heart: love.

41.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_078
41.description: When two men fall for the same woman, even should all things be equal, the feelings of one are destined to be unrequited.

42.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_079
42.description: Thus is there never a shortage of the broken-hearted drowning their sorrows in taverns, and nary an evening goes by without me being called upon to sing mournful ballads of loves lost.

43.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_080
43.description: Yet in spite of the pain that love inflicts, man can stop seeking it out no more than he can choose to stop breathing.

44.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_081
44.description: Nay, he will never cease to struggle to find love. No matter the weight of sorrow and regret he bears, the yearning and desire drives him on.

45.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_082
45.description: For love is the greatest emotion of all. It is a veritable force of nature, transcending reason as it moves us to action. Causing old wounds to tear open anew, again, and again, and again...

46.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_083
46.description: Yet by the same token, it makes the love at which we finally arrive all the sweeter. And we should savor it, and let nothing diminish the joy it brings.

47.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_084
47.description: Even should you taste bitter defeat, the sorrow you feel is testament to the strength of your passion. The flame that burns silently within you, perceivable only to you and you alone.

48.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_085
48.description: There is no need to extinguish that flame. Nay, let it burn until it is spent, and one day, the ashes it leaves behind will become something more than the remnants of your pain.

52.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_089
52.description: Haha, such are the words of a minstrel, my friend. They must be somewhat open to interpretation, that the listener is allowed to find <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> own meaning.

53.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_090
53.description: But I digress. We were speaking about the battle between the Warrior of Light and the Warrior of Darkness...and such a battle it was! An exemplary subject for song!

54.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_091
54.description: I believe I shall place the focus of the piece upon the climax of the confrontation, the better to weave an enthralling epic...

55.name: TEXT_CTSOPN50WANDERINGMINSTREL_00623_PARALLELMINSTREL_000_092
55.description: The epic of two heroes─one arrayed in Light, and one clad in Darkness...
